messages:
Nina (Auditor): Hi team — prepping ISO/SOC evidence. Need: RBAC pre/post snapshots for sampled changes, KMS rotation proof (including key policy hash), vuln-to-incident mapping, and signed bundle with verification steps. Req doc: https://files.redwood.example.com/audits/iso-soc2-asks-2026

Sanjay (eng-security): Quick Q: sampling strategy — do you want a random sample across services or a focused sample on high-privilege roles? Also retention window?

Priya (sec-eng): We can do both. Suggested deliverables:
- samples/rbac/<date>-role-snapshot-pre.csv and post.csv (role -> principal mappings)
- iam/policy-versions/<role>-history.json (exported)
- kms/rotation.csv (key_id, rotation_ts, rotation_version, policy_sha256)
- vuln/triage-map.csv (vuln_id,jira,fix_pr,deploy_ts,incident_id)
- sa/deprov.csv (sa,email,actor,timestamp,pr_link)
We'll sign with our audit GPG key and include sha256 manifest. Timestamps RFC3339 UTC.

Ethan (infra): I'll schedule an export job and attach oncall trace. @ops-bot start export

ops-bot: export queued job=job-2026-05-02-09, started=2026-05-02T09:12:01Z target=s3://redwood-audit-exports/iso-soc2/job-2026-05-02-09

Nina (Auditor): Sampling: focus on high-privilege roles and any changes that affected service accounts. Retention: 1 year preferred. Manifest must include envelope metadata for KMS and mapping file to control IDs.

Priya (sec-eng): Understood. We'll produce a sample bundle covering last 6 months focused on high-privilege role changes. README will include verification steps: verify GPG sig, sha256 sums, and replay CloudTrail event IDs. We'll include control_map.csv mapping files to control IDs (e.g., A.9, CC6).

Sanjay (eng-security): For vuln triage linkage we'll export a compact timeline per vuln so auditor can trace discovery->fix->deploy->incident. We'll include CI pipeline run links for deploy_ts.

ops-bot: update job-2026-05-02-09: bundle created soc2-iso-sample-2026-05.tar.gz uploaded. presigned URL valid 7 days. manifest sig: soc2-iso-sample.manifest.sig

Ethan (infra): Presigned: https://s3-presigned.redwood.example.com/iso-soc2/job-2026-05-02-09/soc2-iso-sample-2026-05.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800 (PMed creds)

Nina (Auditor): Downloaded and verified signature. Initial pass OK. I'll post follow-ups in 48 hrs if any. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Priya (sec-eng): Thanks — standing by for follow-ups and can extend retention if requested.

Sanjay (eng-security): Closing loop once auditor confirms no further items.
